company.name: Chaos Genius
company.shortDescription: Chaos Genius is a provider of a DataOps observability platform for improving data infrastructure efficiency.
company.description:
Chaos Genius is a provider of a DataOps observability platform for improving data infrastructure efficiency. It has developed a unique data infrastructure observability and optimization product that’s initially aimed at Snowflake Inc.’s cloud data warehouse platform. Organizations can save money on Snowflake by receiving automated recommendations to optimize their workloads, identify inefficient queries, and improve query performance. The platform analyzes Snowflake workloads with millions of queries using query patterns to identify inefficient queries and provides intelligent recommendations that significantly improve performance.

The company was founded in 2021 by Preeti Shrimal and Harshit Surana. The company is based in Palo Alto, California.
